snippet.title: Mind Diver - New Platforms Release Trailer | PlayStation®5 & Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Mind Diver is coming to PS5 & Nintendo Switch 2 on August 27, 2026!

■Official Site
https://playism.com/game/minddiver/
■MSRP
Digital Version: $17.99
■Developer: Indoor Sunglasses
■Publisher: PLAYISM

© Indoor Sunglasses ApS. All rights reserved. Licensed to and published by Active Gaming Media Inc.

Investigate a broken mind to unravel a twisted case. 
Deduce the truth. Restore lost memories. 
Listen to private conversations. Draw your own conclusions. 

Mind Diver is a murder mystery, where the victim is love.
